name: github-autopilot
description: AI-powered GitHub repository assistant. Analyze PRs, fix issues, scan secrets, generate tests — over MCP.

authentication.note: Server returns 503 if MCP_API_KEY is unset. Optional MCP_ALLOWED_INSTALLATIONS restricts install-id-scoped tools.

tools.name: analyze_pr
tools.description: Grade a PR (A-F): quality, security, test gaps, blast radius

tools.name: fix_issue
tools.description: Root cause + production-ready fix + verification test for an issue

tools.name: scan_secrets
tools.description: Scan a code snippet for exposed credentials (regex + entropy)

tools.name: generate_tests
tools.description: pytest/unittest suite for a function or class

tools.name: security_review
tools.description: CVE + vulnerability review of code or requirements.txt

tools.name: get_repo_health
tools.description: Repo health grade with dimensions and quick wins
